name: The IIS - Requests Stats
description: The IIS - Requests Stats Dashboard provides visual graphs and statistics for requests made throughout your IIS infrastructure. Dashboard panels show the number of requests, request methods, request outliers, and requests by server. Panels also show details on GET, PUT, POST, and DELETE requests, as well as requests time, compare and unique visitors outlier.
title: The IIS - Requests Stats

| if(sc_status matches "2*", 1, 0) as successes 
| if(sc_status matches "3*", 1, 0) as redirects 
| if(sc_status matches "4*", 1, 0) as client_errors 
| if(sc_status matches "5*", 1, 0) as server_errors

| top 10 server_ip by Requests, UniquePagesServed, AvgResponseTime, MaxResponseTime, MinResponseTime, successes, redirects, client_errors, server_errors
